_about: Demo config mounted at PPC_CONFIG by docker-compose.yml. All four upstreams and the VPNGate controller point at the single mock service on one port; Docker network aliases resolve names, not ports. Copy/edit for your own upstreams; never commit real hosts or credentials.

vg._about: The VPNGate dashboard is served statically at /p/vg/; /p/vg/api/* and /p/vg/ui-state proxy/aggregate against the mock.
